inspiration.observed_pattern: A phonetic name-normalization routine maps consonant groups to Soundex digits, removes adjacent duplicate codes, pads short values, and preserves the initial letter.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Rewritten as an independently authored MariaDB name-audit query using built-in SOUNDEX. The fixture compares case variants, punctuation, short names, empty text, and SQL NULL while preserving deterministic person ordering; the PostgreSQL routine implementation and source data are not copied.

fixture_notes: Robert and Rupert exercise equivalent phonetic codes; Ashcraft and Tymczak cover repeated consonant groups; an apostrophe, empty string, and SQL NULL cover text edge behavior.
determinism_notes: Person IDs and names are fixed, and output is ordered by the primary key with no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE name_audit (person_id INT PRIMARY KEY, display_name VARCHAR(48) NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT person_id, display_name, SOUNDEX(display_name) AS phonetic_code, LEFT(SOUNDEX(display_name), 1) AS initial_code FROM name_audit ORDER BY person_id

checks.sql: SELECT person_id, display_name FROM name_audit ORDER BY person_id
